name: @tyrbo/piece-browser
description: Tyrbo browser automation: runs compiled browser sub-programs on the cloud fleet or a linked device

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.lib.json --noEmit && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --target=node20 --keep-names --tsconfig=../../../../tsconfig.base.json --outfile=dist/src/index.js --log-level=warning && cp package.json dist/
